title: Locator Pins
description: Use Minecraft’s vanilla locator bar as a lightweight waypoint system for bases, death locations, and custom locations.
body:
Adds private custom pins to the vanilla locator bar, Needs to be on the server to work.

## Features

### Custom waypoint pins

Create a pin at your current location with a simple command, and it will appear on the locator bar.

`/pin add Base blue`

![Minecraft house with a locator pin named 'Base' at the bottom.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c47f8c2e89cd6957b64f4b13c5fb0f482f9bc0a.png)

### Last Death waypoint

When you die, your last death location is marked with a pin. The pin clears automatically once you get close to it, or you can remove it manually.

![Pin showcase which shows last death location.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11349dab32c2da14a359d9b5762033ba6db349b8_0.webp)

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `/pin add <name> [color]` | Adds a pin at your current location. |
| `/pin remove <name>` | Removes selected pin. |
| `/pin list` | Shows your pins. |
| `/pin refresh` | Reloads your saved pins. |
| `/pin death clear` | Removes your Last Death pin. |

## Examples

```mcfunction
/pin add Base blue
/pin remove Base
/pin death clear
/pin list
````

## Automatic pins

**Bed** updates when you set your spawn.

**Last Death** is created when you die and clears when you return to it, or with `/pin death clear`.
